description: This file implements custom memory allocation functions zmalloc and zfree, with debugging, logging, and optional statistics collection. It includes memory printing utilities and handles conditional compilation for different malloc implementations.

methods.name: mlt_print_memory_raw
methods.description: Prints raw memory content in a formatted hex and ASCII view, used for debugging memory contents.

methods.name: mlt_print_memory
methods.description: Wrapper for printing memory content, with optional detailed output based on compile-time flags.

methods.name: zmalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory with debugging and optional statistics collection, asserts on failure.

methods.name: zfree
methods.description: Frees memory with debugging and statistics collection.
